note: Global tuning and the assumptions of tools/progression_sim.py. Change a number here, rerun the sim, update docs/03_BALANCE.md.

weary.note: The Weary debuff after a death (modes.json death_debuff_min): stamina comes back slower.

cold.note: Cold regions (regions.json cold): Tale (mild) - no stamina regen without warmth; Saga (full) - health drains. Warmth: a wool coat in the bag, fire in hand, bath steam, or a fire piece (fog_radius) within fire_m.

combat.note: docs/03_BALANCE.md §6. Light hit = weapon damage for weapon stamina; heavy = heavy_k x damage for heavy_stamina_k x stamina. A block takes off the shield's armor.block (block_bare without one) and costs block_stamina; a dodge takes no damage for dodge_s. Bare hands: fist_damage, reach_bare.

spirits.note: docs/01_GDD.md §11. The domovoy moves in at domovoy_comfort; a gift of kalitki every domovoy_gift_days days keeps domovoy_comfort_bonus. The bannik's rule kept (no steam after midnight) makes the steam last bannik_steam_bonus longer. Leshy's wisp leads for leshy_guide_s; the vodyanoy's first fish gives vodyanoy_bite_bonus more bites for the day; resting on the miracle whale gives whale_rested_min; a Chud ruin gives chud_finds once.

steam.note: The sauna stove's steam (docs/01_GDD.md §7.3): warmth and faster stamina for a while.

stations.note: Crafting stations (docs/01_GDD.md §9.3): recipes of sim.background_craft_min_s seconds or longer are loaded into the station and cook without the player; a station holds up to queue_max loads.

sea.note: Sailing (docs/01_GDD.md §8): the sail sets itself; a beam or following wind gives full speed, sailing into the wind headwind_speed of it. The wind turns slowly over wind_period_min.

targets.note: Targets are for an efficient player who knows the recipes (the model). First-time players take about 1.6-2.5x longer; check in playtests (docs/07_PLAYTEST.md).
